lessons.title: Practice Pass-by-Reference
lessons.description: Finish swap_ints. In C++, pass-by-reference (type&) allows functions to modify caller variables efficiently. Implement swap(int& a, int& b). The test checks that x equals 10 && y == 5.
learning_objectives: Ridge potters recount crates before dawn, and use C reference parameters to mutate values.

tests.name: test_swap
tests.test_code: int x = 5, y = 10; swap_ints(x, y); assert(x == 10 && y == 5);
